'''31 BBY''' was the thirty-first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].

==Events==
*[[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] received, in secret, billions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to produce [[Starship/Legends|starships]], vehicles, and equipment for [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|millions of soldiers]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] succeed in capturing a [[Star Temple]] and slaughter many [[Kwi]].<ref name="ie1">[[Star Wars (1998) 23|''Star Wars'' (1998) 23]]</ref>
*[[Ova]] is sucked into a black hole.<ref name="ie1" />
*The mightiest [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] Zalem was defeated and killed by [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and her daughter [[Ros Lai]].<ref name="ie4">[[Star Wars (1998) 26|''Star Wars'' (1998) 26]]</ref>
*[[Gar-Oth's Empire]] is destroyed by [[Yoshi Raph-Elan]].<ref name="Starcrash">[[Star Wars (1998) 27|''Star Wars'' (1998) 27]]</ref>
*The [[Metatheran Cartel]] attempt an economic takeover on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], but their base is attacked and proof of their illegal activities revealed by the [[Cularin resistance]].<ref name="Eye of the Sun trilogy">{{LivingForce|Eye of the Sun trilogy}}</ref>
*The [[Organization]] of [[Nirama]], controlling the crime in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], is threatened by up-and-coming rival [[The Cell]];<ref name="TP">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: TopWorld}}; ''[[Between the Worlds: MidWorld|MidWorld]]''</ref> but The Cell is disbanded by Nirama and his allies.<ref name="UW">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: UnderWorld}}</ref>
*Fallen Jedi [[Karae Nalvas]] and his apprentice [[Saren Valek]] travel to [[Genarius]] where they intend to build a floating fortress, the ''[[Conkesta]]'', destroy the local cities and plunge the system into chaos. Valek's former master [[Alec (Jedi)|Alec]] finds local allies, who defeat Valek and make Nalvas flee.<ref name="Clouds">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Head in the Clouds}}, ''[[Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths|Clouded Paths]]'', ''[[Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds|Into the Storm Clouds]]''</ref> The ''Conkesta'' is destroyed in the planetary core, but immediately after that, the city of [[Tolea Biqua]] is shaken by a radiation storm.<ref name="B">{{LivingForce|Blown Away}}</ref>
*[[Silya Shessaun/Legends|Silya Shessaun]] became the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Thesme]].<ref name="DB-Shessaun, Silya">{{DB|character|silyashessaun|Shessaun, Silya}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' mentions that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force campaign]] begins one year after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. It can therefore be deduced that the campaign begins in 31 BBY.

In [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']], it is incorrectly stated that [[Alexi Garyn]] died thirteen years before [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], placing it in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. He died in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].
